correctness.rationale: All generating one-cycle permutations and ordered subsequences for n=2..6 are exhaustively constructed. The augmented signed-deletion boundaries are checked to square to zero. Exact ±1 integer pivots cancel 2,5,19,88,498 generator pairs respectively and leave identically zero differentials, with remaining generators giving the stated full torsion-free reduced integral homology. Separate original-matrix finite-field reductions at 2,3,101 agree. The proof does not depend on extrapolation.

residual_risks: The search and indexed records do not rule out an unindexed, differently named or privately circulated exact full-cycle-class computation.

Only five finite alphabet sizes are certified; no inference to all n or sphere-wedge homotopy types is made.

value.rationale: The one-cycle conjugacy class is a canonical and maximally transitive group-theoretic generator family. The complete finite cutoff resolves when the top-degree-only homology pattern first breaks in this natural subfamily: at six letters a degree-three class accompanies 88 degree-four classes. This is a motivated exact structural boundary relevant to topology/shellability of structured permutation complexes, not a random small-complex calculation.
